The '''995 Stormcloud ECM suite''' was a [[Jammer/Legends|jamming system]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] and sold for 3000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The jammer was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
